items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Chino Pozo recorded with Fats Navarro; the interviewee responds about Fats Navarro, not Chino Pozo.

ctx.x: No. Now, listen. They don't know.
What -- that reminds me, because Chino Pozo recorded with Fats Navarro. Did you ever play with Fats Navarro?
Oh, yeah, great trumpet player. I'm sorry when he died. Certainly a great trumpet player. We was rehearsing for a new album (inaudible) when he died.
